events.title: Show Us Your Annual “MVP Doll”!
events.description:
Open the Elmo Projector and check your annual data—find the “who fought alongside you the most” page, take a screenshot, and share it in the comments section of (don't forget your UID & Commander name).
• She might be the veteran who carried you through the early game, or a recent pull you've been grinding nonstop because you love her.
• Let's see who's truly the Commander's “MVP Doll”!

events.title: Iliad
events.description:
During the Time-Limited Event Iliad, Commanders can receive generous rewards including Collapse Pieces, Targeted Access Permissions, and Targeting Calibration Chips by participating in event Game Modes.
⟦d.efReq|Commander Level 20⟧
• During the event, Event stages Iliad, Platoon Gameplay Frontier Conquest, Brand-New Game Mode Fantasy Adventure, Splash Bash, Soirée - Prismatic Visions, Event Mission Immortal Defense and Event…
• In the Platoon Gameplay Frontier Conquest, Platoons need to choose a Faction for cooperation.

events.title: Voyage Logs
events.description:
Commanders can earn Mileages by completing Daily Actions, Weekly Actions, and Navigation Calibration to increase the Voyage Logs level.
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 2-2⟧
• After purchasing Hunter's Path to unlock the Voyage Collection, Commanders can obtain additional rewards such as Journey Guardian Custom Gift Box, Collapse Pieces, Targeted Access Permissions, Ovule…
• If Commanders purchase the Broker's Path to unlock the Voyage Collection directly, in addition to the above rewards, Commanders can increase the Voyage Logs level by 10 and get the corresponding…

events.title: Clearsky Pact
events.description:
During the event, log in to the game to receive special assistance from the underground brokers.
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 1-8⟧
• During the event, Commanders can receive free rewards such as Collapse Pieces and Access Permissions by accumulating a certain number of login days.
• Commanders can also pay to unlock the "Advanced Support" rewards, which include additional items such as Outfit Access Permissions, Targeted Access Permissions and Topological Components.

events.title: Outfit Procurement - [Age of Spooms]
events.description:
Perform accesses will have a chance to yield Koleda's and Helen's brand new outfits!
⟦d.efReq|After the Crew Deck reaches level 3 and the relevant function guidance is completed⟧
• Each access has a chance to yield
• Koleda's Outfit - Age of Spooms

events.title: Ex Tenebris
events.description:
During the event, log in for 7 days to receive Targeted Access Permission ×10.
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 1-8⟧
• During the event, log in to receive Targeted Access Permissions as rewards. Log in for 7 days to receive Targeted Access Permission ×10.

events.title: Jubilant Celebration
events.description:
Grand 2nd anniversary giveaway! Log in on December 5th to receive amazing celebratory gifts!
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 1-8⟧

events.title: Shining♥ Manager For A Day!
events.description:
During the event, complete tasks to receive Sharkry's Outfit - Acting Manager for free.
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 1-8⟧
• During the event, complete tasks to receive Sharkry's Outfit - Acting Manager, Collapse Pieces, Basic Info Cores for free.

events.title: Exquisite Teabreak
events.description:
During the event, complete tasks to receive cake and cheer for Dolls to obtain generous rewards including the event-exclusive item Pastel Vouchers, Collapse Pieces, Universal Chain Keys, Doll-exclusive Wall Stickers and…
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 1-8⟧
• During the event, completing the various tasks in the Acquisition Summary will allow Commanders to obtain the cake Pastel Haze.
• Using Pastel Haze to cheer for the Doll will grant you Delicacy Points and increase the Doll's Delicacy Level.

events.title: Crystal Contract - Abundance
events.description:
The first purchase of a Monthly Crystal Contract while the Crystal Contract - Abundance event is active will not be subject to the maximum contract length limitation and will add to the contract length as usual.
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 1-2 and unlock Shop⟧

events.title: [Frontier Conquest] Gameplay
events.description:
Participating in this gameplay, you can experience a brand-new storyline and obtain generous rewards!
⟦d.efReq|Complete Story Campaign Normal Stage 1-8⟧
• Commanders can freely explore in the opened areas. During each Expedition, Commanders can obtain up to 5 Platoon Collectibles.
• After the Frontier Conquest gameplay ends, Commanders can review the storyline of this Frontier Conquest on the Platoon interface.
